aggregates.text: The public gets a say on 5 megawatts at Eielson.
Five spots near Eielson, offered to developers.
The Air Force solicitation covered land at JBER, Eielson and Clear, about 4,700 acres in all. Proposals were due June 29th. KUAC reported no project awarded as of mid-September.

aggregates.note: the isotype's printed unit, a property of the artwork: row A draws 1 block (5 MW, C12), row B 4 blocks plus a 0.6 ghost for 20 to 23 MW (C15, C16), row C 20 blocks plus an open chevron for more than 100 MW (C49), counted by __akAssert
